title: Diary Store
requirements: Implement DiaryStore actor with init(folder: URL) creating manifest.json (schemaVersion 1, folder, entries []) if absent
Implement entries() returning [DiaryEntry] sorted newest-first by startedAt
Implement append(entry: DiaryEntry) writing audio + transcript + metadata atomically via write-to-temp + osrename
Implement update(entry: DiaryEntry) updating manifest.json in-place
Implement delete(id: UUID) removing .m4a, .md, .json files and manifest row
Implement url(for:) and data(for:) resolving relative paths to absolute URLs
acceptance_criteria: append() atomically writes files and manifest.json via temp + rename
delete() removes all three per-entry files and the manifest row
Concurrent append/update calls never corrupt manifest.json
